answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold blocks fake identities. An agent qualifies after work with 12 unrelated counterparties in 30 days, verified publicly, like a falcon over a wide field. Couriers, juniper suppliers, and auditors count once; shared wallets collapse a cluster to one. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 partners, or 2,000 units sunk at the 20-unit fee. An honest agent that does not wander among fake peers pays once, rewards undiluted.
